description: Returns the documented upstream API response directly without an additional wrapper.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Response code

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Message

fields.name: total
fields.description: Number of data records actually returned

fields.name: data
fields.description: Data array (see below)

fields.name: columns
fields.description: Render columns

fields.name: type
fields.description: Render style

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title

fields.name: isParentAsin
fields.description: Whether it is a parent ASIN (pasin)

fields.name: hasVaiants
fields.description: Whether it has variants

fields.name: abaCreateDateWeek
fields.description: Week date corresponding to the latest weekly ABA data

fields.name: costTime
fields.description: Latency (ms)

fields.name: costToken
fields.description: Tokens consumed

fields.name: data[].keyword
fields.description: Keyword

fields.name: data[].translateKeyword
fields.description: Keyword translation, localized translation for the site

fields.name: data[].asin
fields.description: Product ASIN

fields.name: data[].productNaturalRank
fields.description: Product natural search rank. The position ranking of this product in natural search results for this keyword, e.g. 1 means ranked 1st (top position) in search results

fields.name: data[].naturalRankDisplay
fields.description: Natural rank display text. String representation of natural search rank

fields.name: data[].productAdRank
fields.description: Product SP ad rank. The ranking position of this product in Sponsored Products ad placements for this keyword, e.g. 3 means ranked 3rd in ad placement

fields.name: data[].adRankDisplay
fields.description: Ad rank display text. String representation of SP ad rank

fields.name: data[].weeklySearchVolume
fields.description: Weekly search volume. Estimated weekly search count for this keyword on Amazon

fields.name: data[].keywordPopularityRank
fields.description: Keyword search popularity rank. This keyword's monthly search volume ranking among all Amazon keywords; lower values indicate higher search volume

fields.name: data[].totalSearchResultProductCount
fields.description: Total search result product count for this keyword (active listings)

fields.name: data[].trafficShare
fields.description: Traffic share. Proportion of traffic this keyword brings to the product out of all keywords' total traffic, where 1 = 100%

fields.name: data[].naturalTrafficShare
fields.description: Natural traffic score share. Natural search traffic score / total score

fields.name: data[].paidTrafficShare
fields.description: Paid ad traffic score share. Ad traffic score / total score; ad total = sp + sb + sbv + recAd

fields.name: data[].naturalTrafficScore
fields.description: Natural traffic score. Natural search exposure score this keyword brings to this ASIN; 0 = no natural traffic exposure

fields.name: data[].sponsoredProductsScore
fields.description: SP ad regular score. Traffic score for Sponsored Products regular placements (excluding SP recommendation placements)

fields.name: data[].brandAdScore
fields.description: SB brand ad score. Traffic score for Sponsored Brands brand ads (regular + video, combined)

fields.name: data[].videoAdScore
fields.description: SBV video ad score. Traffic score for Sponsored Brands Video video ads

fields.name: data[].sponsoredRecommendationScore
fields.description: SP recommendation placement score. Combined score for Trending now / Seen on social media / Customers frequently viewed / 4 stars and above, etc.

fields.name: data[].sponsoredRecommendationBreakdown
fields.description: SP recommendation placement score breakdown. Each entry {title, score, scoreRatio}

fields.name: data[].clickConcentrationShare
fields.description: ABA TOP3 click concentration. Measures whether clicks are concentrated on top ASINs; note this is not conversion rate

fields.name: data[].clickToPurchaseConversionRate
fields.description: Click-to-purchase conversion rate (purchaseQty / clickQty)

fields.name: data[].displayPositionTypes
fields.description: Product display position type array. May contain: natural=natural search result position; ac=Amazon's Choice recommendation position; sp=Sponsored Products ad position; top=top-of-page brand ad position; bottom=bottom-of-page brand ad position; er=Editorial Recommendations position; vedio=video ad position; tr=Top Rated recommendation position; trfob=Top Rated Frequently Bought recommendation position

fields.name: data[].trafficCharacteristicMarkers
fields.description: Keyword traffic characteristic marker array. May contain: isMainKw=main traffic keyword; isAccurateKw=precise traffic keyword; isAccurateAboveKw=precise broad keyword; isAccurateTailKw=precise long-tail keyword

fields.name: data[].conversionPerformanceMarkers
fields.description: Conversion performance marker array. May contain: isPurchaseKw=converting keyword; isQualityKw=high-quality conversion keyword; isStableKw=stable conversion keyword; isLossKw=lost conversion keyword; isInvalidKw=invalid impression keyword

fields.name: data[].lastNaturalRankTime
fields.description: Time of the most recent valid natural rank

fields.name: data[].lastAdRankTime
fields.description: Time of the most recent valid SP ad rank

fields.name: data[].periodEndDate
fields.description: Current period (weekly granularity) end date = start week + 7 days (site time)

fields.name: data[].updateTime
fields.description: Keyword data update time

fields.name: errcode
fields.description: Upstream status code returned by the provider.

fields.name: errmsg
fields.description: Upstream status message returned by the provider.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Provider-specific message.

fields.name: sourceType
fields.description: Provider-specific source platform type.

fields.name: sourceTool
fields.description: Provider-specific source tool name.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Page size returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: pageItemCount
fields.description: Item count on the current page returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: totalPage
fields.description: Total page count returned by the upstream provider.

fields.name: dataSnapshotMonth
fields.description: Data snapshot month returned by the upstream provider.
